unresolved_notes.forthepeople.com: Excluded from every cohort. Morgan & Morgan holds an office here and in roughly a thousand other markets, and a profile on this site asserts one home market.
unresolved_notes.moseleycollins.com: Moseley Collins Law. Its structured data lists Sacramento first and then Seattle, Fresno, San Diego and San Jose, and describes a practice serving three states. Portland is one of its state pages and a single office; the firm is a California one.
unresolved_notes.searsinjurylaw.com: Sears Injury Law. Nine offices in its structured data and eight of them are in Washington, headed by Puyallup, with its own title reading Washington State Personal Injury Lawyers. The Portland address on Halsey Street is the ninth.
unresolved_notes.lawtigers.com: Not a law firm. Its own about page says the American Association of Motorcycle Injury Lawyers, which uses the name Law Tigers, is an association of independent firms whose members pay a membership fee to be included, in addition to advertising fees, and calls it a referral service. There is no firm here to score, no Oregon roster to check, and paid inclusion is the thing this directory exists to be an alternative to.
unresolved_notes.elginjurylaw.com: ELG Injury Lawyers. Its first verified listing is in Boca Raton and the number on its own pages is a 561 one, which is Palm Beach County. Portland is a second office.
unresolved_notes.senftlegal.com: Senft Legal. Its own pages ask whether you want to hire a Florida personal injury lawyer and answer that its Florida lawyers work on contingency, and its number is a 954 one. No Google listing matched the domain either, so there is nothing here to measure against Portland firms.
